output:
Done. Both contract verification commands pass, and the full suite (103 tests) is green.

Changed paths:
- `bridge/accounts.mjs` — slot-based locking: slot 0 stays `locks/<id>.lock`, extra slots are `locks/<id>.<n>.lock`, all with the same pid/stale rules; `acquire` takes the first free of `max` slots and throws `account_locked` only when all are held; `max` = account `maxParallel` → `MUSE_MAX_PARALLEL` → 1 (capped at 50); new `busySlots(id)`, `maxParallelOf(id)`, `setMaxParallel(id, n)`; `isLocked` = every slot busy; `pickAccount` sorts by fewest busy slots then LRU; `removeAccount` deletes all slot files.
- `bin/musebridge.mjs` — `accounts list` appends `busy/max` (and `busy`/`max` in JSON); new `accounts set <id> --max-parallel <n>` (1..50) writing `maxParallel` into accounts.json; help and usage updated.
- `tests/account-slots.test.mjs`, `tests/acp-slots.test.mjs` — new files; existing test files untouched.
- `bin/muse-acp.mjs` — no change needed: `waitForLock` already polls `acquire`, each session keeps its own `museChatId`, so two sessions now run in parallel on separate slots and separate Muse chats.

Verified: `node /tmp/muse-slots/check.mjs "$PWD"` → OK; `node --test tests/account-slots.test.mjs tests/acp-slots.test.mjs` → 9/9; `accounts set work --max-parallel 5` persists and `accounts list` prints `0/5`; whole suite 103/103.

APPROACH: Kept the single-lock file as slot 0 and added `<id>.<n>.lock` siblings so the default path (max=1) is byte-for-byte the old behaviour; the effective max resolves account → env → 1, and every lock read/write reuses the existing stale-pid rules. The ACP binary needed no edits since its lock wait and per-session chat id already satisfy the invariants.

LESSON: `node --test tests/` (bare directory) fails in this repo with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; use `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` for a full-suite regression check.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
